UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Links', 'joomlaguide-links', '

In this tour you add a link to the article Our Services: to the website of Joomla, which powers this site.

You also make the editor bigger, and see how to edit, remove and test a link.

This tour follows the tutorial 3.4 Links of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 3.4 Links', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Open Our Services', '

Click Our Services to open it for editing.

', 3, 'right', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Make the editor taller', '

Drag the resize handle in the bottom right corner of the editor downward, to see more of the article while you work.

Then click Next.

', 4, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Fullscreen', '
  1. Click the Fullscreen icon, four small arrows pointing to the corners (in the second row, under ⋯), or press Ctrl+Shift+F (on a Mac ⌘+⇧+F). The editor fills the window.
  2. Click the icon again, or press the same keys, to return to the normal size.

Then click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-article .tox-tinymce,.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Type a sentence', '
  1. Click at the end of the paragraph under Support.
  2. Type a space and this sentence:
    This site is proudly built on Joomla, the content management system behind millions of websites worldwide.
  3. Select the word Joomla in that sentence. The popup toolbar appears.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Insert the link', '

Click the link icon in the popup toolbar. The Insert/Edit Link window opens. Fill it in:

  • URL: https://www.joomla.org
  • Text to display: already Joomla, the word you selected.
  • Title: The Joomla Website
  • Open link in...: New window

Click Save in that window: Joomla is now a link. Then click Next.

Why a new window? joomla.org, like many sites, refuses to show itself inside a frame, and the Preview of Joomla is a frame.

', 7, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Save your progress', '

Click Save, not Save & Close.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-article #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Try the link', '
  1. Click Preview. A window shows your article.
  2. Scroll down to Support and click the link Joomla. The Joomla website opens in a new tab.
  3. Go back to this tab and close the preview with the × at its top right.

Then click Next.

', 9, 'bottom', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) #toolbar-preview .button-preview', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Edit, remove or test a link', '

Right-click the link Joomla in the editor. A menu appears:

  • Link... opens the Insert/Edit Link window again.
  • Remove link removes the link but keeps the text.
  • Open link opens the link in a new tab, to test it while you edit.

Click in the text to close the menu without choosing. Then click Next.

', 10, 'right', 'body.view-article:has(#system-message-container:not(:empty)) fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-links'), 'Well done!', '

Our Services now links to the Joomla project from its Support section.

In the next tutorial, Tables, you finish the article with a table of plans and prices.

', 12, 'top', '#articleList tbody tr:first-child', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
